digest.component_or_area: pytest conftest teardown / snapshot fixture cleanup
propositions: macOS CI pytest basetemp cleanup fails with PermissionError when snapshot-producing tests leave read-only .rebar/run_snapshots directories because teardown is owned only by the module-local fixture in test_snapshot.py

snapshot publishers intentionally set 0444/0555 permissions via snapshot._chmod_readonly, making residual .rebar/run_snapshots/<sha> trees non-removable by ordinary shutil.rmtree after tests in other modules create snapshots
shared pytest teardown in tests/conftest.py must centrally enforce removal of exact .rebar/run_snapshots roots below each test-owned tmp_path using the existing snapshot._rmtree_writable seam

snapshot tests must remain read-only during execution (0444/0555 permissions enforced) while all .rebar/run_snapshots cache roots become removable after shared conftest autouse fixture teardown completes
